The onboarding route (app/routes/onboarding.tsx lines 326-330) converts 'invalid_padding' into a distinct HTTP response ('corrupted' vs 'restart'), giving an attacker a padding oracle to decrypt and re-encrypt/forge tokens one byte at a time. The comment on lines 29-33 explicitly acknowledges this. The newer benefits-election token correctly uses GCM with a single generic error, confirming the flaw. Fix: use an authenticated cipher (AES-GCM) or add a MAC and return a uniform error.
